_about: Regions of the decode path that no VIN can reach. Every entry needs a reason naming the mechanism, not the symptom. `make coverage` fails if an unlisted region is uncovered (a new gap) and also if a listed one becomes covered (the reason expired — usually a data refresh made the branch reachable). Refresh counts with `make coverage-update`.

allow.reason: public wrapper; decode calls check_digit_with_flag directly, so no VIN routes through it
the non-17-character early return; cover VINs are 17 characters so that arm stays cold
the I/O/Q rejection arm; a WMI containing one cannot form a VIN whose digit is then computed
per-position I/O/Q and class-mismatch arms; cover VINs are well-formed so those rejects stay cold
Dec::parse - sign and exponent forms no displacement value in the data uses
Dec::weight_and_firstdigit - the zero-magnitude arm; a displacement of 0 is not in the data

empty-operand short circuit, unreachable from parsed displacement values
negative operands and the exp<0 branch; all six vpic.conversion formulas are positive multiply/divide
division-by-zero guard and unparseable-operand arms; no formula divides by zero
the all-nines carry that grows the number a digit; no displacement in the data rounds that way
